posts.title: Memory dump in Kubernetes with kubectl debug and dotnet-dump
posts.description: One of the classic bugs is the memory leak. Even garbage collected languages like C# can leak memory, even if all the code is safe/managed. Sometimes such issues are easy to find and fix. posts.description: Scheduled GitHub Actions are now (in May 2026) so delayed that they are more or less useless.
